accommodation: 25 rooms and suites, each named after a past guest, in 1930s Art Deco style
suitableFor: Couples, special-occasion stays, house parties and weddings
beachAccess: Tidal island reached across the sand from Bigbury-on-Sea or by sea tractor at high tide
confirmedFeatures: Mermaid Pool, tennis, snooker, spa and wellness treatments, three dining options including The Pilchard Inn
overview: Burgh Island Hotel sits on a small tidal island just off Bigbury-on-Sea, reached across the sand at low tide or by the hotel's sea tractor when the tide is in. It has 25 Art Deco rooms and suites, a natural sea pool, tennis, snooker and spa treatments, with The Pilchard Inn among its dining options.
surfTripFit: Looks directly onto Bigbury and is across the estuary from Bantham, but this is a formal, special-occasion hotel; tidal access and no stated storage make it awkward for carrying boards.
gaps: Parking (on mainland), dogs, children policy and Wi-Fi not stated on homepage; tide/access details to confirm with reception.
